title: Puffs, or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic
description: “Puffs, Or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic” is a delightful theatrical production by Matt Cox, presented by the Silver Line Theatre Exchange in special arrangement with Concord Theatricals. This family-friendly show tells the story of the Puffs, a group of misfit students who navigate seven years at a certain Wizard School, overshadowed by a famous boy wizard who saves the world. This comedic tale is perfect for anyone who has ever felt less than extraordinary, featuring area university students aspiring to careers in theatre. While it is suitable for families, it does include scenes of violence, death, and sexual innuendo. The performance runs for approximately 110 minutes, with a 15-minute intermission.

The Junction is mixing up specialty themed cocktails and mocktails just for the occasion. The first 100 guests will receive a magical gift! 100% of ticket sales go to BICSV's Critical Need Fund, which helps brain injury and stroke survivors across the Shenandoah Valley stay housed, keep the lights on, put food on the table, and access the vocational support and adaptive technology they need to thrive. This event is for ages 21+ only. Come cast a spell for a good cause! title: Puffs, or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic
description: “Puffs, Or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic” is a delightful theatrical production by Matt Cox, presented by the Silver Line Theatre Exchange in special arrangement with Concord Theatricals. This family-friendly show tells the story of the Puffs, a group of misfit students who navigate seven years at a certain Wizard School, overshadowed by a famous boy wizard who saves the world. This comedic tale is perfect for anyone who has ever felt less than extraordinary, featuring area university students aspiring to careers in theatre. While it is suitable for families, it does include scenes of violence, death, and sexual innuendo. The performance runs for approximately 110 minutes, with a 15-minute intermission.
